quality_caveats: This is not a repair package and made no TeX patch.
The RA10 local cutout source is readable enough for orientation and rough checking, but embeds page images around 2048 x 3322 px, roughly 360 ppi.
The source witness is below the current strict 650+ ppi page-checking target and far below the 1000+ ppi dense-math crop target.
Direct extracted embedded image objects can be misleading because the PDF stores separated image objects; use the source PDF or normal renders if consulting this witness.
Paper 42 remains open for high-resolution source acquisition and later source audit.
publish_decision: Hold for a future grouped Noether source-audit/source-quality update. Do not micro-upload unless preparing a deliberate Noether source-quality guardrail update, and do not describe as Paper 42 closure or critical-edition certification.
